posts.title: I'm not a real doctor.
posts.description: Getting there.Another day of great weather. One more day. One day more. There are changes coming. The old man gets older. He has been enjoying our walks, but his system is unhappy. Poor mangy, rangy kitty. Throughout our Tiger Nation Years, he's been our own Tiger. I don't need to start missing him now. Now he is here, he is with us. And he's still full of love.Distance: 3.75 miles Duration: 32:
